query:
UPDATE requests.system_prompts rsp
                            SET prompt_sha256 = $2,
                                system_prompt_id = sp.id,
                                unknown_blocks = NULL
                           FROM system_prompts.system_prompts sp
                          WHERE rsp.request_id = $1
                            AND sp.prompt_sha256 = $2
                            AND rsp.prompt_sha256 IS NULL
